contract: Input: the part name N, the property name P and the value text V of a _setProperty call on a loaded form. A part that does not resolve ends the call.
P selects this rule when the CRC-32 of its upper-cased bytes equals that of Anime. Any other P is not this rule.
Let W be ShowInactive when V is exactly Show, byte for byte, and V otherwise.

Each part holds one latched Execute string that starts empty. When W equals the latch the call ends with no effect. Otherwise the latch becomes W and the call continues. A cell state not read here can refuse the write before the compare, and then the latch does not change.
The command is the one named ApplicationCommands. followed by W, matched byte for byte. When no command has that name the call ends.

The command executes on the part with an empty parameter record. PreviewExecuted tunnels first and the call ends when a handler marks it handled. Otherwise Executed bubbles from the part to the nearest Window, whose handler runs the effect below.
ShowInactive: set Visibility to Visible, then raise Shown on the window every time.
Hide: when the window allows hiding, raise Hiding. When no handler cancels it, set Visibility to Hidden.
InvisibleWindow: set Visibility to Hidden and raise nothing.
Show: set Visibility to Visible and raise Shown only when the window was not visible before. Anime never produces this command.
A _setProperty of Visibility stores the value and raises neither Shown nor Hiding.
The receiver byte and the Window_LogWidget global need no state. The first always passes and the second is read as never set.

open.label: UNKNOWN
open.question: The cell flags 0x01, 0x02 and 0x40 tested by 0x0095E830 and 0x0095E500 are not named, and the value the engine call 0x00912850 passes as the info setter's third argument is not traced. The store returns without writing when flag 0x02 is set and that argument is 0, or when flag 0x02 is clear, the argument is 1 and flag 0x01 is clear. The reference branch can end the call with flag 0x10 set and no store. Whether an Anime part reaches those states is not known.

open.label: INFERRED
open.question: No instruction names 0x0135708C except its two reads and its address is zero filled, so the Window_LogWidget skip reads as dead. A register-relative or runtime write is not excluded. The neighbouring globals 0x01357080, 0x01357084 and 0x01357088 each have one absolute store at 0x00924D88..0x00924D9C, so the area holds a small cluster of globals.

open.label: CALIBRATION
open.question: The latch suppresses a second Anime Show that has no other Anime value between, and the store can refuse a write before the latch compare in the cell states above. Applying either changes what a script sees when it calls Show twice. A live walk of the retail client decides whether to apply them.
